messages.author: Andrew
messages.text:
Base it off the basic cost to produce, sell for a mark up, and buy below rate. Maybe if people can SEE the prices on the market they will want to undercut, but there's still an issue where most resources have NO sellers or buyers. 

Not such a big deal in other games where there's barely any resource types, or where resource type only matters for specific stuff you can specialise out of, but here all the buildings you need for anything basically spread the resource needs to several terrain types, so you can't just ignore market.
